vocabulary.meaning_en: give someone confidence or hope to do something

vocabulary.example: He felt deflated after the bad news.

vocabulary.meaning_en: end in a good way; be successful
vocabulary.meaning_ar: ينجح / تسير الأمور على ما يرام
vocabulary.example: Don't worry. Things will work out.
Don't give up. You're almost there.

vocabulary.meaning_en: think about something too much, in a way that worries you
vocabulary.example: Don't overthink it. You did your best.

vocabulary.meaning_en: words that show you admire someone's work
vocabulary.example: Workers like to get some praise.
Your English is improving. Keep at it!

vocabulary.meaning_en: try something to see if you like it or can do it
vocabulary.example: I've never done judo, but I'll give it a try.
There's no money at stake, so just try.

vocabulary.meaning_en: make yourself work harder to improve
vocabulary.example: Keep pushing yourself to learn more.

vocabulary.meaning_en: (informal) don't give up when things are difficult
vocabulary.example: Hang in there. Only two exams left!

vocabulary.meaning_en: a breath that shows you are happy a worry is over
vocabulary.example: When the exam ended, I breathed a sigh of relief.

fine_lines.title: give up vs give it a try
fine_lines.explanation_ar: give up = يتوقف عن المحاولة (يستسلم). give it a try = يبدأ المحاولة (يجرّب). المعنيان متعاكسان تقريبًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Give up" = stop trying. "Give it a try" = start trying. They are almost opposites.

examples.sentence: Never give up on your dreams.
French looks hard, but I'll give it a try.

fine_lines.title: It might work out fine vs I'm sure it'll be fine
fine_lines.explanation_ar: might تعني احتمالًا (ربما ينجح)، أما I'm sure it'll be fine فتعني ثقة أكبر.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Might" shows possibility; "I'm sure it'll be fine" shows more confidence.

examples.sentence: It's a risk, but it might work out fine.
Don't worry, I'm sure it'll be fine.

expressions.example: Come on, you've studied hard. You can do it!

expressions.meaning_ar: ربما تسير الأمور على ما يرام.
expressions.meaning_en: Says there is a risk, but it could end well.
expressions.example: Take the new job. It might work out fine.

expressions.phrase: Don't give up. / Never give up.
expressions.example: You've come too far. Don't give up now!

expressions.meaning_ar: أنا متأكد أن الأمور ستكون بخير.
expressions.example: Don't overthink it. I'm sure it'll be fine.

expressions.meaning_en: Says something good could happen, so try.
expressions.example: Enter the competition. You never know!

expressions.meaning_en: Praises someone and encourages them to continue.
expressions.example: Great report, Sara. Keep up the good work.

expressions.meaning_en: Tells someone to continue working hard.
expressions.example: You're getting better every week. Keep at it!

expressions.meaning_en: Encourages someone to try something new.
expressions.example: You might enjoy swimming. Give it a try.

expressions.phrase: What do you have to lose? / What have you got to lose?
expressions.meaning_en: Says there is no real risk in trying.
expressions.example: Ask your boss for more responsibility. What have you got to lose?

expressions.phrase: What's the worst that can happen?
expressions.meaning_ar: ما أسوأ ما يمكن أن يحدث؟
expressions.example: Just ask. What's the worst that can happen? They say no.
Keep pushing. The exercises will get easier.

expressions.meaning_en: Encourages someone in a hard situation.
expressions.example: Only four kilometres to go. Hang in there!

expressions.meaning_ar: حاول ثم حاول ثم حاول مرة أخرى.
expressions.meaning_en: A saying: keep trying until you succeed.
expressions.example: My grandmother always said: try, try and try again.

expressions.phrase: If you're not in, you can't win.
expressions.meaning_en: You must take part to have a chance.
expressions.example: Apply for the scholarship. If you're not in, you can't win.

grammar.title: Imperatives for encouragement: Don't + verb / Keep + -ing
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم صيغة الأمر للتشجيع: Don't + الفعل (Don't give up)، وKeep + الفعل بـ ing (Keep pushing, Keep trying)، أو Keep + اسم (Keep up the good work).
grammar.explanation_en: Use imperatives to encourage: Don't + verb (Don't give up); Keep + -ing (Keep pushing, Keep trying); Keep up + noun (Keep up the good work).

grammar.title: might vs will for predictions
grammar.explanation_ar: might + الفعل الأساسي للاحتمال (قد يحدث)، وwill للتوقع الأكثر ثقة، وغالبًا مع I'm sure.
grammar.explanation_en: Use might + base verb for possibility; use will for a more confident prediction, often with "I'm sure".
examples: I'm sure it will be fine.
You might win. You never know.

questions.question: Your friend is running a marathon and is very tired. You shout:
questions.explanation_ar: Hang in there تشجّع شخصًا في موقف صعب.
questions.explanation_en: "Hang in there" encourages someone in a hard moment.

questions.question: A manager praises a worker. Which phrase fits best?
choices: What have you got to lose?
questions.explanation_ar: Keep up the good work عبارة مدح وتشجيع للعامل.
questions.explanation_en: "Keep up the good work" praises a worker.

questions.question: Keep ___ yourself to learn more.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد keep نستخدم الفعل بـ ing.

questions.question: "Don't overthink it" means:
choices: Don't think about it too much.

questions.question: Which shows the MOST confidence?
questions.explanation_ar: I'm sure ... will تُظهر ثقة أكبر.

questions.question: Which is the OPPOSITE of "give up"?
questions.explanation_ar: keep at it = استمر، وهي عكس give up.
questions.explanation_en: "Keep at it" = continue; opposite of "give up".

questions.question: "What have you got to lose?" means:
choices: There is no real risk in trying.
questions.explanation_ar: تعني أنه لا توجد خسارة حقيقية في المحاولة.
questions.explanation_en: It means there is no real risk.

questions.question: "I felt deflated after the exam" means I felt:
Enter the competition. You never ___!
questions.explanation_ar: You never know = ربما يحدث شيء جيد.
questions.explanation_en: "You never know" = something good might happen.
